message: All 41 obligation rows declare schema_version='proof-obligations/v1' (plural). The canonical schema per go-skill/references/proof-schemas.md §Required Schema Versions is 'proof-obligation/v1' (singular). Additionally, the required field 'domain_claim' is missing from all 41 rows. Schema validator will fail on every row.
required_fix: (1) Rename schema_version to 'proof-obligation/v1' (singular) on every row. (2) Add a 'domain_claim' field to every row — a one-sentence plain-English statement of the property being verified. (3) Optionally collapse the redundant 'id' / 'obligation_id' duplication.
blocker_reason: Schema validator fails on all 41 rows. proof-writer downstream consumes this JSONL; cannot materialise specs without a validating input.

message: PO-NT-P-09's expected_evidence field contains the Rust expression 'from_str::<T>(&to_string(&t).expect(...))' implying .expect() inside the proptest body. But clarity-web/src/domain/mod.rs:7-9 unconditionally denies clippy::expect_used at module level (inner attribute, not gated by cfg(test)). The plan's own notes field claims this is fine in #[cfg(test)] — that claim is FACTUALLY INCORRECT for the domain module. The deny applies to all code in domain/, including #[cfg(test)] mod tests inside domain/newtypes.rs.
required_fix: Choose ONE of: (a) Re-instruct proof-writer to use .unwrap_or_else(|_| String::new()) or .unwrap_or_default() instead of .expect(...). (b) Annotate each proptest function with #[allow(clippy::expect_used, clippy::unwrap_used)]. (c) Move the proptest file out of domain/ to clarity-web/tests/newtypes_proptest.rs (RECOMMENDED — cleanest fix, isolates test from module lints).
blocker_reason: PO-NT-P-09 as written cannot be implemented under the domain module-level deny lints. proof-writer would add test bodies that fail cargo clippy -p clarity-web --all-targets -- -D warnings.

message: §4 row 'F (Flux)': non-applicability rationale is 'Verus covers the same refinement properties with more rigour at the same author cost. cargo-flux is installed but unused for this module.' This is author preference, not concrete evidence per go-skill/references/verification-lane-policy.md §Non-Applicability.
required_fix: Strengthen to a concrete module-property statement. Examples: 'No refinement predicate in newtypes.rs is expressible in Flux but not Verus — all five newtypes have at most one refinement shape (!s.trim().is_empty() or parse_from_rfc3339(&s).is_ok()), which Verus already pins via ensures.' OR 'Flux installation is N.N.N but no refinement type in newtypes.rs falls within Flux's lower-bound arithmetic/refinement sweet spot (Verus owns that surface).'
approval_ref: pending owner ratification on concrete module-property grounds
rationale: Lane decision is likely correct; rationale is just weak. Acceptable to track as owner-approved debt if the owner strengthens the rationale before proof-writer runs.

message: Plan §9 Blocker #4 mentions cl-2q6 (clippy debt) but does NOT mention cl-2vr (CRITICAL P0 per formal-verification-report.md §3). cl-2vr is the missing [lints] workspace = true opt-in in clarity-web/Cargo.toml — workspace deny lints are INERT for clarity-web. 901 panic-prone sites exist. For domain/newtypes.rs specifically the panic-freedom assumption is sound (0 panic-prone sites in this module's 307 lines), but the plan should cite the module-level inventory as the basis, not the workspace lint configuration.
required_fix: Add a one-line note to §9 Blocker #4: 'cl-2vr (CRITICAL P0) is acknowledged. For domain/newtypes.rs specifically, the module-level panic-freedom assumption is independently defensible — the source has zero .unwrap(), .expect(), panic!, todo!, unimplemented!, or unsafe sites — so the panic-freedom basis is the module inventory, not the (inert) workspace lint config.'
approval_ref: verifier concurs module inventory is the correct basis
rationale: Low severity for THIS module (0 panic-prone sites). Closure of cl-2vr itself is owned by holzman-rust and tracked separately as a CRITICAL P0 bead.

message: PO-NT-V-25 (Timestamp::default) declares verus_mode='exec'. Body (line 305) calls Self::now() which has extern_spec on chrono::Utc::now() and chrono::DateTime::to_rfc3339(). Mode should be 'exec+extern_spec' for consistency with PO-NT-V-24.
required_fix: Change verus_mode from 'exec' to 'exec+extern_spec' on PO-NT-V-25 row.
rationale: Trivial fix; mechanical alignment with PO-NT-V-24. proof-planner updates the row before re-submission.

message: PO-NT-V-17..V-21 (Display::fmt for each newtype) use verus_mode='exec+external_body'. Under external_body, Verus does NOT verify the body produces the spec postcondition — it asserts the spec is consistent and trusts the body. The plan's §8 bridge table mentions PO-NT-P-07 (proptest_display_roundtrip) as the bridge, but the obligation rows themselves do not cross-reference PO-NT-P-07. Without explicit cross-reference, a future reader sees 5 vacuous Verus obligations with no compensating evidence.
required_fix: Add compensating_evidence_refs: ['PO-NT-P-07'] field to PO-NT-V-17, PO-NT-V-18, PO-NT-V-19, PO-NT-V-20, PO-NT-V-21 obligation rows.
approval_ref: plan §8 bridge table already cross-references PO-NT-P-07 for Display
rationale: external_body is the canonical pattern for Display::fmt (Verus cannot fully model fmt::Formatter); PO-NT-P-07 is the legitimate compensating evidence. The bridge is documented; only the obligation-row cross-reference is missing.

message: PO-NT-V-25 (Timestamp::default) is structurally a one-liner delegation to Timestamp::now() at line 305. PO-NT-V-24 already covers the same property (RFC 3339 compliance of as_str()). The plan §5 acknowledges this ('Body is a one-liner that delegates to now(); the spec asserts the same postcondition') and keeps the separate row for coverage.
required_fix: Add to PO-NT-V-25 notes field: 'Structurally duplicates PO-NT-V-24 (Timestamp::default delegates to Timestamp::now at line 305). Same property; separate row for coverage of Default trait surface.'
approval_ref: verifier concurs separate row for Default trait coverage is reasonable
rationale: Coverage vs. deduplication trade-off; the plan's choice is acceptable. Cross-reference prevents future readers from re-deriving the property.

message: PO-NT-P-09's expected_evidence field contains a Rust expression ('from_str::<T>(&to_string(&t).expect(...)) == Ok(t.clone())') interleaved with prose ('proptest: for arbitrary valid input...'). The mixing makes automated evidence extraction harder.

rationale: Cosmetic; does not affect plan correctness. Worth fixing while addressing F-BLOCK-2 which touches the same row.

message: Plan does not record the planner invocation ID in any machine-readable field. Per go-skill/references/review-provenance.md, reviewer and planner invocations must differ; independent review requires evidence outside the reviewed artifact. This reviewer assumes the host control plane tracks this; the workspace Markdown is not enough. The proof-writer and proof-reviewer downstream should add planner_invocation_id to obligation rows so the chain is hashable.
required_fix: Add a planner_invocation_id field to the obligation JSONL schema (or to the plan Markdown header) so the reviewer chain is traceable. Owner: host control plane or proof-planner.
approval_ref: verifier concurs this is a host-control-plane concern
rationale: Informational; the reviewer chain is not the only safety net. Acceptable to track as a debt for a future proof-planner version.
